title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：sorrow　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sorrow 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the elder ① bore the sorrow that no youth in the village would have noted, and he said the bearing was the whole of the year. The ② sorrow, meaning the grief itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; sorrow, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ bit of sorrow in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ sorrow at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Sorrow, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the elder said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sorrow was the whole of the matter, meaning the regret and not the grief. The ⑥ sorrow, meaning the regret and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; sorrow, he said, is either something you bear or the only word that means both grief and a regret. He said the regret is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ sorrow had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ sorrow of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of noting; sorrow, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sorrow I remember is the sorrow noted in the memoir, which closed in 1971 and is still noted as the quietest in the village. ⑩ Sorrow, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all sorrow, she said, is a regret that has agreed to look like grief. She said the regret was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 悲伤；悲痛（指村子里每一点旁边的那一点）
B. n. 悲伤；悲痛（指那分悲伤本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：bear the sorrow 承受这一分悲伤
D. n. 悲伤；悲痛（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 悲伤之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的悲伤之事）
F. n. 悲伤；悲痛（指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一分）
G. n. 悲伤、怅惘（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 怅惘（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bore the sorrow that no youth in the village would have noted
The sorrow, meaning the grief itself and not the staff
Every bit of sorrow in that village
the sorrow at the far gate
the sorrow was the whole of the matter
the sorrow had become a line in a memoir
The sorrow of the whole thing

answers.why: bear the sorrow 意为“承受这一分悲伤”，1964 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯记下的一分悲伤做了一遍。
sorrow 意为“悲伤；悲痛”，指那分悲伤本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记下。
sorrow 意为“悲伤；悲痛”，指村子里每一点旁边的那一点，每一点旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
sorrow 意为“悲伤；悲痛”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sorrow 意为“悲伤、怅惘”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这分怅惘就是那件事的全部。
sorrow 意为“怅惘”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那分悲伤，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sorrow 意为“悲伤；悲痛”，指回忆录里写到、被记下的那一分，到 1969 年这一分成了回忆录里的一行。
sorrow 意为“悲伤之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的悲伤之事是一处村子和三个年头的记下。
sorrow 意为“悲伤；悲痛”，我记得的是回忆录里记下过的那一分，1971 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一分。
sorrow 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，悲伤是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的悲伤。
